      "type": "objection",

      "status": "fixed",

      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "approach",
      "text": "test against CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_FRONTEND_VARIANT instead of if(MSVC)",

    },
    {
      "id": "rc:3775137545",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "question",
      "kind": "maintenance",
      "text": "whether the #elif branch in byteswap.h should be removed since MSVC support is dropped",

      "status": "open",
      "status_note": "",
      "author_replies": [],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "",
      "status_by_quote": ""

      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "text": "suppressing -Wno-return-type in CI may hide C++ standard violations or potential undefined behavior",
      "quote": "Is this a violation of the C++26 standard? ... If not, it should not be hidden, to be able to confirm it.",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "open",
      "status_note": "",
      "author_replies": [],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "",

  "support": [
    {
      "id": "c:2545554465",
      "verdict": "",
      "reason": "Seems fine to add this, because it is easy to remove and can increase the build compatibly in the meantime. Also, it allows to evaluate the codegen, which could be substantially better than msvc, or detect more msvc bugs.",
      "substantive": true,
      "evidence": "read",
      "areas": []
    },
    {
      "id": "r:4926426721",
      "verdict": "Concept ACK",
      "reason": "Concept ACK ec347d1108d57d682bdc239558b8ca2660be6a3a after testing native Windows build and verifying CMake flags",
      "substantive": true,
      "evidence": "both",
      "areas": [
        "cmake/module/TryAppendCXXFlags.cmake",
        "CMakeLists.txt",
        "src/compat/byteswap.h",
        "doc/build-windows-msvc.md",
        ".github/ci-windows.py"
      ]
    }
  ],
  "waiting_on": [
    {
      "on": "author",
      "what": "author response to maflcko's concern regarding -Wno-return-type and hodlinator's question on byteswap.h",
      "id": "rc:3801801387"
    }
  ],
  "notes": "Updated claims under the new schema: fanquake's objection on adding another compiler was fixed when the author dropped MSVC support; added theuni's CMake suggestion and hodlinator's question on byteswap.h; maflcko's question/objection on suppressing -Wno-return-type remains open awaiting author response."
}
